summary: Full end-to-end testing of Indian Renal Diet mobile app (Expo web preview) completed successfully. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me), foods (list/search/tier/detail with swap resolution), meal-logs (auth-gated CRUD with persistence verification), and AI ask (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key). Frontend: E2E playwright flow validated login → search with chips → RED food detail (Palak Paneer) showing Smart Swap Card recommending Lauki Sabzi → add to meal log → Meals tab showing correct summary pills (Safe/Caution/Avoid) and log entries → Ask AI returning full CKD-focused answer → Settings toggling English/Hindi (verified Hindi labels: सेटिंग्स/भाषा/साइन आउट) → Sign Out redirects back to Login. Seed data of 35 foods and 10 swaps confirmed. All testIDs work as documented.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (or platform-specific shadow API). Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: styles across theme/components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/etc.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents instead. Likely inside a react-native-web dependency (safe-area-context / keyboard-controller). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Address shadow* deprecation warning by migrating any shadowColor/shadowOffset/etc. styles to boxShadow (RN 0.76+) or wrap them platform-conditionally.
(Non-blocking) Investigate props.pointerEvents deprecation - likely originates from a dependency; verify with react-native-web upgrade or wrapping component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: clean, all routes prefixed with /api, MongoDB _id excluded from projections, async everywhere, JWT with 30-day exp, timing-safe login (dummy hash on missing user). Good.
seed_data.py: 35 foods + 10 swaps, stable string IDs, upsert-based seeding (idempotent). Good.
Frontend uses testIDs consistently, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env, no hardcoded URLs. StyleSheet.create used throughout; all text wrapped in <Text>. Good.
seed_data_creation: Registered a throwaway test user (test_<uuid>@renal.app) during register test — one-off, no cleanup needed. Demo user (demo@renal.app) already present and reused. Meal-log create test cleans up after itself via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://kidney-safe-swap.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Demo user demo@renal.app / demo123. Tab labels are 'Search', 'Meals', 'Ask AI', 'Settings' (NOT 'Meal Log'). All 35 seeded foods have IDs like food-<slug>. Smart-swap only returned for RED tier foods.
rca_of_issue: No app bugs found. Only two Playwright script issues on first run were self-inflicted: (a) matched Meal Log tab by wrong text ('Meal Log' vs actual 'Meals'), (b) counted AI response messages before the 30s Claude latency completed. Both were fixed and re-verified in a second run; app itself worked correctly the entire time.
